info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Ecommerce Cart Checkouts-v5-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Checkout List API provides a streamlined way for businesses to retrieve detailed information about customer cart checkouts. This endpoint allows users to access a comprehensive list of completed checkout transactions, enabling the analysis of customer purchasing behavior and cart conversion rates. Typical consumers include eCommerce analysts and platform integrators who rely on this data for reporting and business intelligence purposes. Use this API to enhance your understanding of the checkout process and optimize your sales strategy.

get.summary: Initiates the checkout process for the shopping cart.
get.description: This endpoint triggers the checkout process and retrieves the necessary information for the user to complete their purchase. It ensures that all items in the cart are ready for payment and provides relevant details about shipping and billing options.

requestBody.description: The request body for initiating the checkout process in the shopping cart. It contains necessary details such as item identifiers and user information required to complete the transaction.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsRequest.description: Represents the request body for the checkout operation in the cart service.

status.description: Indicates whether the checkout operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the checkout transaction.

resultId.description: The identifier of the result for the checkout operation.

state.description: The current state of the checkout process.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time taken for the checkout operation, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional context or information about the checkout process.

audit.description: Audit information related to the checkout operation.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsResponse_200.description: Schema representing the success response of the checkout operation.

createdBy.description: The user who created the checkout entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the checkout entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the checkout operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing audit information for checkout operations.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request in milliseconds. A value of 0 indicates that the operation completed instantaneously.
